plan.notes: Source: 'Suggested Four Year Plan — Bachelor of Science in Computer Science' (the general BS, no concentration), in the Department of Computer Science's official undergraduate catalog PDF, Tennessee State University, retrieved 2026-09-30 from https://www.tnstate.edu/computer_science/documents/CS_UG_Catalog.pdf. Catalog year: the department PDF is an undated edition published as the department's current undergraduate catalog (the explicitly archived edition is the separate file CS_UG_Catalog_2020_2021.pdf); the current official university catalog on catalog.tnstate.edu is the 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog, whose College of Engineering page lists 'Computer Science, B.S.' (with Bioinformatics, Cybersecurity and Networking, and Data Science concentrations) — the same program lineup this document covers. Transcription method: manual, course-by-course transcription of the printed term-by-term table (8 semesters); every course code, title, and credit value is verbatim from the table, and per-term sums were recomputed and verified against the table's stated totals (16/14/15/17/16/15/14/13 = 120 credits). Prerequisite codes are from the same document's official course descriptions. Caveats: (1) The junior-fall table row prints 'Natural Science (2)', but official note (2) is Social/Behavioral Sciences while note (3) is Natural Sciences — an apparent typo in the official table; transcribed as a Natural Science slot per note (3) and the 12-credit Natural Sciences distribution (4+4+4). (2) COMP 4500's official prerequisite is 'Graduating Senior' (a status, not a course code), documented here rather than as a prereq code per schema rules. (3) The Acalog program pages on catalog.tnstate.edu carry the same 'Suggested Four Year Plan' headings but their plan tables do not render as extractable text, so the department's official catalog PDF — which the Acalog catalog content mirrors — was used for the term-by-term table. (4) The 2023-2024 archived Acalog page titled 'Program: Computer Science, B.S.' (catoid=9, poid=1295) shows a different distribution that includes Bioinformatics Concentration Courses (13); the department's current published catalog structures the general BS as transcribed here (CS Core 37 + Computer Science Electives 12 + Technical Electives 9). Students should confirm their catalog-year requirements with an advisor.
